fields.title: Input column
fields.description: Select the String column containing JSON content.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Output column
fields.description: Choose whether to replace the input column or append a new column.

fields.title: New column name
fields.description: Name of the new JSON column.

fields.title: Allow comments
fields.description: Allow comments (/* */, // and #) within JSON strings. Note: Comments are not part of the JSON specification but are sometimes used.

fields.title: Fail on error
fields.description: If checked, the node fails when encountering invalid JSON. Otherwise, missing values are generated for invalid JSON strings.
